screen.name: Edit Task
screen.purpose: Edit an existing task using the same task-form pattern as Create Task, including its audio attachments.

sections.label: Description
sections.placeholder: Write additional details about this task...

cover.selectionRule: Exactly one attached image may be selected as cover when images exist.
cover.defaultRule: The first added image becomes the cover automatically.
cover.tileUse: The cover image is used as the task image on task tiles.

withAudioAttachment.description: Shared with Create Task. Compact audio attachment card with Play, Voice recording, duration, more_vert, and Transcribe with AI. No progress bar until playback starts.

visualRules: Use global design tokens from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors, radii or arbitrary spacing.
The reference PNG is a visual target, not a source of token values. Do not measure colors, spacing, or radii from it.
Edit and Create must use the same task-form composition and shared components.
Populate all fields from the existing task.
Images are attachments; the selected cover image is used on task tiles.
The title microphone opens Title Recording. It does not create an audio attachment and does not use this transcription flow.
Audio attachments sit after Description and before Images. Existing recordings are listed with playback.
Create and Edit render attachments with the same audio-attachment-list and audio-attachment-card. Do not fork a second attachment component.
Several recordings are allowed, and each keeps its own transcription state.

Transcribe with AI stays on the attachment. It does not open a waiting sheet. The card shows Transcribing... with an indeterminate indicator and no percent. Other fields stay editable, and playback stays available.

When transcription finishes, the card shows View transcription only. Do not also show Transcription available. View transcription opens the shared transcription sheet. It does not call speech-to-text again.
A transcription error stays on the card as Transcription failed · Retry. The recording remains. Do not auto-retry and do not open an error sheet.
Transcription failed uses semantic danger. auto_awesome is only the Transcribe action icon. Do not add a glow, a decorative waveform, or an extra sparkle on the card.
The saved transcription belongs to the audio attachment and is kept independently of the description. It is stored with the attachment and synced with the task. It is not a separate sync system.
Add to description appends the saved transcript to the description draft. It does not replace the description or the audio file.
Delete recording lives in the attachment more_vert menu. Removing an attachment also removes its transcription and is included when changes are saved. Task View does not delete attachments.

The default audio attachment card is approved in states.withAudioAttachment via task-create-with-audio.png. Playback progress appears only after playback starts. The transcription sheet stays draft until its own reference PNG is approved.
Tags have a single entry point. Use the Add tags selector to add or create tags; do not render a separate Add tag action beside selected tag chips.
Do not show a trash/delete icon in the header.
Do not show a clear-X control inside the title field.
Task deletion belongs to Task View options, not the Edit form.

reference.description: Approved visual reference for the Edit Task screen.

angular.note: Create and Edit share task-edit today. The default audio attachment card is approved via task-create-with-audio.png. audio-transcription-open stays draft until its reference PNG is approved. Same data-shape caveats as task-create.json: single imageId, no dueDate on TaskDTO. The form offers Waiting and Active, plus a conditions multi-select (To do, Calendar, Location). A note is edited without a status or conditions selector. Mark as Active requires the todo condition. Mark as Active and Done are Task View actions. Task View does not show a status section. Calendar and location conditions do not store a date or place yet. Mockup counters are not TaskConst. Speech-to-text returns only a transcript string and no progress percent.
